settings.name: Max Frame Rate
settings.reason: Global caps stay off; FPS caps belong to VRR or game-specific profiles.

settings.name: Low Latency Mode
settings.reason: Global defaults avoid stacking driver latency controls with in-game Reflex.

settings.name: Power management mode
settings.reason: Avoids forcing maximum clocks globally, especially on laptops.

settings.name: Shader Cache
settings.reason: Keeps NVIDIA shader caching enabled without clearing or resizing by default.

settings.name: Texture filtering - Quality
settings.reason: Performance texture filtering is reserved for explicit competitive profiles.

settings.name: Threaded optimization
settings.reason: Lets the driver choose the safe path per workload.

settings.name: Vertical sync
settings.reason: Global sync policy stays application-controlled until a display or game profile is planned.
